text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our junior year in the books, we
welcome
the new one—a year in which
the Classics begin.
And as for Mejiro
Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Continuing with the latest Twinkle Series
news,
here's a new name for you to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: She's a daughter of the Mejiro Family and a star on the rise, it's Mejiro Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Debuting only last year, Mejiro Ardan happens to be the younger sister of the Mejiro Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: Hooooo boy, with a living legend like her in the family, every race she runs must come with a whole heap of pressure. I bet lots of fans are hoping to see her follow in her sister's footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
It would seem so. Predictions of how
close she'll
come to matching Mejiro
Ramonu's achievements
are already
trending on social media.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I looking forward to working alongside
you this
year as well.
choice_data_list: あけましておめでとう

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I see you were watching television.
May I
ask—

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: That's a tall order if you ask me. She did win the first ever Triple Tiara, after all. Nothing short of excellence can even hope to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Please don't mind me. I'm quite
used to
being compared to my sister,
and I've been
expecting to hear
comments like those.
choice_data_list_en: Sorry. I'll turn it off right now.
Sorry. I'll turn it off right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, it's entirely true that I'm not
shining as
brightly as she did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not yet, at least. I've no intention of
resigning
myself to the present status
quo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm determined to forge my own path
and push
ahead so that my light can
reach the hearts and
minds of the many.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, it's thanks to you that I was
able to
experience so many special
moments during my
junior year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of what anyone might say, I
am proud
of the path I've taken thus far.
As such...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please don't pay such matters any mind,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Um, despite what I just said, may I
have a quick
word?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There's something I wish to tell you regarding my—no, our venture into classic year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I have a certain goal in mind for the
year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Although... it won't come into view for a
little
longer, so I feel that sharing the
details this soon
may be somewhat
presumptuous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As such, I'd like to wait until the spring
Classics
are closer before I make any
commitments. If I've
achieved good
enough fitness and experience to

attempt a G1...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Might I trouble you then for some
advice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Does it sound odd, coming from me? I
thought it
might. I speak so often of "the
now" and "the
moment" that touching
upon the future so
suddenly must be—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's commitment to focusing

exclusively on the moment is the source
of her
strength. I know that better than
anyone. But
still...
choice_data_list_en: No, it's the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though she's only looking a little
further
ahead, part of me is happy to
hear her talk about
the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing you say that makes me very
happy.
Until that day, please continue
to guide me.
choice_data_list: いつか相談されるのが、楽しみだ
いつか相談されるのが、楽しみだよ
choice_data_list_en: I look forward to you coming to me for advice someday.
I'm looking forward to you coming to me for advice someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We go on to review her upcoming
training
regimen. Then, while taking a
break after
finishing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Do you have a little time to
spare?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have a minor request to make...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time we've seen each
other this
year. Shall we mark the
occasion with a seasonally
appropriate
activity?
choice_data_list: 空いているけど、どうかしたのか？
空いているけど、どうかしたの？
choice_data_list_en: I'm free, but did something happen?
I'm free, but is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I usually spend New Year's with the
younger
Mejiro children, but I think I'd
like to try
something different this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Assuming that's all right with you,
Trainer... What
do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never expected an invitation like this,
but a
break from the usual routine might
be good for
her. In terms of activities,
New Year's is the time
for...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Pin the nose on the snowman!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful idea, Trainer! Do you
have the
necessary materials in your
office?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...As embarrassing as it is to admit, I've
spent a
great deal of time by myself
over the years, so I
haven't had many
opportunities to play games
with others.
choice_data_list_en: Y-you look really happy, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I'm quite elated to receive
an
invitation to play a game...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Was my reaction improper?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan is always so even-keeled
that I can't
help but smile after seeing
such a rare, giddy grin
on her face.
choice_data_list_en: I think that's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I fetch the game set out from the closet
in my
office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Right... This must be the nose. Which
means that
goes here... and the eyes go
there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Finished!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to a normal face, Mejiro
Ardan's
creation... looks more like a
unique take on
cubism.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pffft! Hehe! I wasn't even close!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is much harder than it appears.

Right. It's your turn now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Show me how it is done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ardan and I start the
year with
some lighthearted laughs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm partial to mochi soup myself.
And though
New Year's Day has come
and gone, I can't think
of another
activity more appropriate for this time
of
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine the cafeteria will have several
kinds of
New Year's dishes available for
a limited time.
Eating there is an option,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me to... cook some
mochi soup
for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I thought that preparing you some mochi
soup
using the Mejiro family recipe
might be a nice way
to show how much I
appreciate all your hard
work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nanny has taught me the basics, so I
assure you I
won't be serving anything
inedible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her request catches me off guard. But at
this
moment, that's what she wants to
do, and as her
trainer, I can't ignore
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much. I shall begin
preparing
right away.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、お言葉に甘えようかな
choice_data_list_en: Then maybe I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan heads to the cafeteria to
gather the
ingredients together, then
gets to work in the
kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your patience. Your meal
is ready.
Do help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She serves a bowl of hardy soup filled
with fish
and veggies. The aroma of the
soy-based broth
makes my mouth water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chunkier ingredients have been cut
up neatly
and the mochi cakes are a
perfect golden hue.
Mejiro Ardan's
attention to detail is on full
display. It's
just that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not that it tastes bad. The flavor is
subtle and
nutritious. I just can't help
feeling like it's a little
plain.
choice_data_list_en: (...Is the flavor a bit light, maybe?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Was the flavor on the weak side?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You needn't withhold criticism,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely apologize for this. It appears
that my
bad habit has resurfaced.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For whatever reason... I tend to end up
making
dishes that lack flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps my palate has grown
accustomed to
weaker flavors due to my
long hospital stays, and
that comes out
in my cooking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My older sister teased me about it
actually. She
said my cooking tasted like
the hospital cafeteria
food she used to
eat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I've wasted my opportunity to
cook for
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This mochi soup has shown me a new
side of
Mejiro Ardan. For me, that alone
means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This taste represents one of the
countless
"moments" Mejiro Ardan has
experienced. There's
no way it could be
anything other than delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...You truly are a kind person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, while eating mochi soup
together, we
chat cheerfully about
random stuff and enjoy a
laid-back start
to the new year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Flying a kite!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful suggestion! Let's
absolutely do
that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... I've never flown a kite
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was rarely able to play outside during
my youth,
so I often daydreamed about
flying the kites I saw
bobbing about in
the distant sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But the years kept passing by without an

opportunity ever presenting itself. That
is, until
today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, let's!
choice_data_list: なら、全力で凧揚げをしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's put everything we've got into flying kites!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After pulling a kite out of storage, we
head down
to a park just around the
corner from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. My heart's racing. Perhaps I'll
have a knack
for flying kites.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hi there! Are you gonna fly a kite too?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Come join us! We're kite-flying pros!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Thank you so much for the
invitation. This
is my first time at the
helm of a kite, actually.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Here, we'll show you what to
do!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, first you need to choose who's
gonna hold
the kite and who's gonna fly
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We've done it, Trainer! Our kite is
airborne!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Nice! Now it's our turn!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Let's see whose kite goes the highest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Ardan flying a kite so
innocently
alongside these kids warms
my heart. What a nice
way to start the
new year...
